title: WO brief v2: sub-trade words, one fact envelope with confidence and on-site decision, research by reference, key messages
steps: S1: Run the sub-trade, fact confidence, fact decisions, key messages and brief v2 tests of packages/wo/website-opportunities.
S2: Run the tracy-web test that reads the research of a revision by reference.
expect: S1: every test passes: sub-trade words come from the fixture, each fact carries confidence and an on-site decision, key messages are built from them.
S2: the revision holds a reference to its research and the research resolves from it.
evidence: PR 1794 builds the brief v2 envelope; these existing test files fence each part of it
fence: pure domain functions and the research reference reader; no database needed
